31721.en: A_{b} is the center of the circle that is the inverse-in-B-Soddy-circle of the C-Soddy-circle. A_{c} is the center of the circle that is the inverse-in-C-Soddy-circle of the B-Soddy-circle. B_{c}, B_{a}, C_{a}, C_{b} can be constructed cyclically. (Randy Hutson, March 21, 2019)
no: Let (I) be the incircle of ABC and B', C' the orthogonal projections of I on AC, AB, respectively. Denote B", C" the points other than B',C' where lines BB', CC' cut (I), respectively. The tangents to (I) at B" and C" cuts BC at A_{b} and A_{c}, respectively. Build B_{c}, B_{a}, C_{a}, C_{b} cyclically. Then these six points lie on a conic with perspector X_7 and center X_31721. (César E. Lozada, March 18, 2019)
